rationale: Add Cargo dependency caching (registry and git) to the lint and build jobs. The workflow already caches npm dependencies via setup-node, but Cargo dependencies were not cached. Each build job runs Cargo to compile native code, and the lint job also runs Rust checks. Caching the Cargo registry avoids repeated downloads across runs and matrix configurations. This optimization is supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) which reports modest aggregate benefit, and by a measured experiment (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) showing ~9% elapsed time savings when adding a dependency cache step. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable (Cargo runs in every build job), and cache inputs include a lockfile (Cargo.lock) and environment (runner OS). The change preserves all build and test coverage and does not weaken permissions or add privileged actions.
